advice: Do not squeeze or pick lesions. Avoid oily cosmetics and hair oils on forehead. Mild dryness or redness in first 2 weeks is expected; reduce frequency if irritation. Take doxycycline with plenty of water, do not lie down for 30 minutes.
name: Acne vulgaris (mild to moderate)

rx.instr: Apply pea-sized amount on whole face at night

rx.sig: Apply every morning and reapply every 3 hours outdoors
